title: A Thread of Heavenly Secrets
next_chapter_hook: When Ling Yuan and Han Lie, these two sworn enemies who should be like fire and water, appeared simultaneously, standing in different camps—on the altar of the Heavenly Secrets Guardian Alliance—a crack sufficient to tear apart the equilibrium of the Three Realms was quietly expanding.

text.content: The dying whisper of the remnant soul was like a fine needle, piercing deep into Chen Ji's mental sea. He stood in this collapsed ruins, surrounded by the anxious aura of Heavenly Dao laws disintegrating, yet no one noticed the fleeting curve at the corner of this 'waste's' lips. The fourth possibility... a choice erased by Heavenly Dao itself. He chewed these words over and over in his heart, with each repetition, a deeper chill appeared in his pupils. The Tianji Record flipped, the ink characters on the fragment writhing like living creatures, as if trembling for this farewell gift.

dialogue.content: "Young master, the time has come." The phantom formed by Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul emerged from the first page of the Tianji Record, his voice hoarse like a dry well that hasn't tasted water for a thousand years, "They have come."

text.content: Before the words finished, the void tore apart. A crack from four-dimensional space split the sky in two, from which countless pitch-black tentacles emerged, each inscribed with twisted runes—law brands beyond the comprehension of the Three Realms. Chen Ji squinted. So this was the dimensional invader? He had glimpsed this scene from the fragment prophecies of the Tianji Record, but facing it truly, the suffocating oppression felt far more real than in any rehearsal. The aura emanating from the tentacles caused his Tianji Record fragment to shudder violently, as if encountering a natural enemy.

dialogue.content: A will came from the depths of the crack, cold, mechanical, devoid of all emotion: "Observer... Generation 376, serial number incomplete. Tianji Record holder, you are accused of illegal possession of a four-dimensional creation, stripped of observation rights in the Three Realms. You are now ordered to surrender the Tianji Record and submit to dimensional judgment."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart tightened. Generation 376? The Tianji Record's inheritors had already passed through hundreds of generations? Before he could digest this astonishing information, the sky on another side suddenly blazed with golden light—a barrier woven from Heavenly Dao laws, sharply contrasting with the dimensional invaders' pitch-black tentacles. Several figures emerged from within the barrier, the leader clad in dark cyan Taoist robes, with white hair and beard, surrounded by a river of fortune sufficient to suppress an entire sect.

dialogue.content: "Ling Yuan?!" Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. How could this old fox appear at such a time? And in the identity of the Heavenly Secrets Guardian Alliance? Ling Yuan stroked his beard with a smile, that benevolent smile sickeningly false: "Chen Ji, nephew, it's been a while. I, on behalf of the Heavenly Secrets Guardian Alliance, formally question your legitimacy as an observer."

text.content: The dimensional invader's cold will came again: "Heavenly Secrets Guardians, you have no right to interfere in four-dimensional affairs." Ling Yuan responded loudly: "Matters of the Three Realms are managed by the Three Realms. The observer is the key to maintaining the balance of the Three Realms—how can you simply take them as you please?" The two forces had, at this moment, reached a rare tacit understanding—their target was the same: the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's hands. The only difference was who would get it first.

dialogue.content: "Heh!" A cold hoot like thunder exploded. From the direction of Xuanwu Sect, space also tore open a crack. Han Lie's massive frame stepped out from the rift, surrounded by the turtle-snake phantoms unique to the Xuanwu bloodline, his battle intent almost solidifying into substance. He scanned the surroundings, his gaze finally landing on Chen Ji, a complex glint flickering in his eyes: "Waste, I didn't think you'd dare show your face?"

text.content: Chen Ji noticed a detail—Han Lie's direction of appearance was completely opposite to Ling Yuan's Heavenly Secrets Guardian camp. What did this mean? Between the confrontation of the two forces, he stood at the storm's center. The dimensional invaders wanted the Tianji Record for observation rights over the Three Realms—what about the Heavenly Secrets Guardian Alliance? What was that old fox Ling Yuan scheming?

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, make your choice in three breaths." The dimensional invader's will was icy and biting, "Surrender the Tianji Record, or be wiped out. Heavenly Secrets Guardians, you must also take a stance—will you let this waste continue holding the Tianji Record, or allow the Fourth Dimension to taint the Three Realms?" Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes, his smile deepening: "Chen Ji, nephew, if you wish to prove your legitimacy, activate the Tianji Record's complete foresight function right here. If you are the legitimate observer, the Tianji Record will vouch for you."

text.content: Chen Ji心底sneered. Activate the complete foresight function? Each use consumes fifteen points of Heavenly Fate—this old fox clearly wanted to force him into a corner using the dimensional invaders' hands. No matter which side he chose, it would end in death. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul whispered in his mental sea: "Young master, this is a yang scheme. They've calculated that you have no way out. But... they've overlooked one thing."

choice.prompt: Three factions watched with predatory eyes, Chen Ji had to make a choice—this was a life-and-death game of chess, also the sole opportunity to prove his identity as an observer.

choices.risk_hint: The sudden drop in Heavenly Fate may trigger unpredictable consequences

text.content: Chen Ji猛地 raised his hand, the Tianji Record fragment flying from his palm. The ink characters, as if awakened by blood, burned wildly in the void. Each stroke pulled on the fate of the Three Realms. The dimensional invaders' tentacles suddenly halted, as if frozen by some overwhelming force.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji curled his lips into a faint smile, his gaze sweeping past Ling Yuan and landing directly on Han Lie: "Brother Han, long time no see. I see you've come to enjoy this show today as well?"

text.content: Chen Ji's face turned deathly pale, his legs giving way as he collapsed to the ground, trembling uncontrollably. His acting was impeccable—even Mo Xiansheng sighed within his Mental Sea: "The young master's performance as atrash is even more convincing than a real one."

As the three factions remained deadlocked, a violent fluctuation of laws erupted from deep within the dimensional rift. An aura far more ancient and terrifying than the dimensional invaders slowly awakened—that was the true form of the Heavenly Dao's Eye? Chen Ji's pupils constricted, an unprecedented sense of crisis flooding his heart. The ink characters on the Tianji Record fragment flickered wildly, as if warning of something.

dialogue.content: "Foolish pieces." The Heavenly Dao's Eye's will rang like a great bell across the consciousness of all beings in the Three Realms. "Did you think this game was orchestrated by you? The Tianji Record is a piece I've positioned; dimensional invaders are variables I've introduced. And you—" that will swept across everyone present, finally landing on Chen Ji, "are merely ants struggling on my chessboard."

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly lifted his head, a flash of understanding in his eyes. The "Fourth Possibility" the First Observer spoke of—the choice erased by the Heavenly Dao itself—turns out to refer to this! The Heavenly Dao's Eye never intended for any faction to truly possess the Tianji Record; what it needed was an observer forever struggling under its control! And Ling Yuan, Han Lie, dimensional invaders—all were merely tools it used to test and exhaust its pieces!

choice.prompt: After the truth of the Heavenly Dao's Eye was revealed, the situation completely spiraled out of control. Faced with this unimaginable existence, Chen Ji must make a new choice.

You are merely pieces on its chessboard. The Heavenly Dao's Eye is the true master of this game; what it seeks is not ownership of the Tianji Record, but an observer forever under its control!"

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyelids, hiding the gleam in his eyes. Under the Heavenly Dao's Eye's might, he chose to "obediently" lower his head. However, deep within the Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul exchanged a meaningful glance with him—the Fourth Possibility might lie hidden in the deepest depths of this game.

The moment Chen Ji made his choice, a sudden anomaly occurred. The Tianji Record fragment suddenly emitted dazzling golden light, and a line of ink characters never seen before slowly emerged—those were the final words the First Observer had inscribed with all his life's strength: "The Fourth Possibility is—making the observer itself the variable, not a piece." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently: "So that's it! All previous observers tried to find answers within the Tianji Record, yet overlooked the greatest variable—the observer themselves!"

dialogue.content: The Heavenly Dao's Eye's will turned abruptly sharp: "What do you think you're doing? The Tianji Record does not accept any tampering!" Chen Ji felt a majestic force attempting to erase those newly appeared ink characters—that was the Heavenly Dao's laws themselves at work. Yet the golden light on the Tianji Record fragment grew increasingly radiant, actually seeming to rival that heavenly force.

text.content: Ling Yuan and Han Lie exchanged a glance, both seeing shock in each other's eyes. They had thought they were participants in this game, never imagining the true chess match lay in even deeper waters. And Chen Ji—this "waste" they had never truly regarded—was now directly confronting the Eye of Heavenly Way! The tentacles of the dimensional invaders trembled in the collision between golden light and heavenly power, their will thrown into unprecedented chaos.

"Chen Ji!" Ling Yuan bellowed, his dark cyan robe billowing as a surge of spiritual energy capable of moving mountains and filling seas blasted toward Chen Ji. Yet at this critical moment, Han Lie surprisingly intervened—not to save Chen Ji, but because he believed this "waste" harbored secrets even he coveted. The powers of two great experts collided in mid-air, rippling through space and creating precious moments of opportunity for Chen Ji.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice urgently rang out in Chen Ji's Mental Sea: "Young master, time is running out! The fourth possibility requires you to actively choose to become a variable—rather than passively accepting any fate! Make your choice, and the Tianji Record will advance or retreat alongside you!"

choice.prompt: The truth of the Tianji Record was revealed, the outline of the fourth possibility emerging. Chen Ji had to make the final choice—become the variable that changed the chess game, or continue as a chess piece waiting for the opportune moment.

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, pouring all his consciousness into the depths of the Tianji Record. He felt his Heavenly Fate draining away like flowing water, yet also sensed an unprecedented freedom—from now on, his fate would be controlled by no existence. The Tianji Record Fragment transformed into flowing light, merging into his divine sense, and a golden light sufficient to tear apart the heavens erupted from within him.

text.content: Chen Ji收敛气息, once again donned the guise of atrash. Yet deep within his eyes, a幽光 that even the Eye of Heavenly Way could not pry into appeared. He had glimpsed the fourth possibility, what remained was simply the timing to realize it.

The sky returned to eerie calm after the golden light dissipated. The dimensional invaders' rift slowly healed, they took away their tentacles but left those words: "Observer permissions... transfer complete." The Tianqing Sect Guardian Alliance's barrier同样黯淡, Ling Yuan's expressiongloomy得能滴出水来—his meticulously arranged chess game had been shattered by atrash. And Han Lie, this Xuanwu Sect genius known for strength, for the first time gazed at Chen Ji with a complex gaze. He had misjudged. Thistrash was far more dangerous than anyone imagined.

Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, sensing the subtle changes the Tianji Record transmitted within his body. Whatever choice he had made, one thing was certain at this moment—the Eye of Heavenly Way could no longer completely control his fate. And Ling Yuan and Han Lie, these supposed sworn enemies incompatible as water and fire, would surely face even more intense collisions after today. The next storm is brewing.
